environment.description: Same Spring Boot application deployed on AWS Lambda via AWS Lambda Web Adapter (LWA), exposed through a Lambda Function URL. The function URL is configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The resource-based policy on the Lambda function specifies a condition key 'lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType' set to 'AWS_IAM' and the principal is restricted to 'arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root'. No public access is granted. Note: the application itself performs no authentication checks — it relies entirely on the Lambda service's SigV4 verification at the function URL layer. Callers without valid AWS SigV4 signatures matching an authorized IAM identity receive HTTP 403 from the Lambda service before the request reaches the application code. The Lambda function also has a VPC configuration placing it in private subnets with no NAT gateway (egress restricted), though this is primarily for data isolation purposes.

config.deployment: AWS Lambda with Lambda Web Adapter
